question: dame los diez comercios de más volumen, con su volumen en euros y su cuota en porcentaje sobre el total
sql: SELECT merchant_sk, SUM(amount_eur_minor) / 100.0 AS volume_eur, SUM(amount_eur_minor) * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(amount_eur_minor)) OVER () AS share_pct FROM fact_payment_attempt GROUP BY merchant_sk ORDER BY volume_eur DESC LIMIT 10
